facts: No new snow measured at the 2 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left Stevens Pass (3,940 ft) and Fish Lake (3,440 ft) 14 to 15 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Stevens Pass
evidence.detail: left May 7; earlier seasons: May 21 (2023), May 24 (2024), May 22 (2025)

evidence.name: Fish Lake
evidence.detail: left April 30; earlier seasons: May 16 (2023), May 14 (2024), May 7 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Stevens Pass (3,940 ft) and Fish Lake (3,440 ft).

evidence.name: Stevens Pass
evidence.detail: 23.6 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 40.0 in (2023), 30.2 in (2024), 32.5 in (2025)

evidence.name: Fish Lake
evidence.detail: 13.2 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 24.6 in (2023), 19.9 in (2024), 16.8 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between May 3 and July 17, carried from the melt-out dates at Stevens Pass (3,940 ft) and Fish Lake (3,440 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Stevens Pass
evidence.detail: melted out May 7, 1,841 ft below the pass; points to May 4 to July 14

evidence.name: Fish Lake
evidence.detail: melted out April 30, 2,341 ft below the pass; points to May 2 to July 19
